title: The Liturgy of the Tentative Calendar Invite
core_theme: The passive-aggressive manipulation of temporal real estate.
narrative_spec: Deconstruct a last-minute, Friday afternoon calendar notification marked 'Tentative' from an upper-level director.

title: The Taxonomy of the Sealed Tower Window
core_theme: The total physical insulation of capital from the climate.
narrative_spec: Analyze the triple-paned, unopenable glass of a financial skyscraper on a beautiful spring day. GOD why was I not a finance major........... F**K

title: The Mid-Year Calibration Hagiography
core_theme: The algorithmic standardization of human performance.
narrative_spec: Set the scene inside a closed-door talent calibration meeting where managers trade metrics to rank human beings on a bell curve. elevate the language to a tea room setting if possible... if not then whatever. But make it fancy.

title: Anatomy of the Sycophantic Email Sign-Off
core_theme: The performance of artificial enthusiasm under economic duress.
narrative_spec: Deconstruct the micro-choices involved in writing an email response to an absurd executive directive. Hold back? Nope. Give me everything.

title: The Epistemology of the Complimentary Pizza
core_theme: The insultingly cheap tokenization of collective overwork.
narrative_spec: What makes you feel valued at work... for me its giving Low grades. Really fills my void.

title: The Geometry of the Ergonomic Task Chair
core_theme: The mechanical preservation of the spine for optimal utility.
narrative_spec: Analyze the luxury of a workspace. or the lack of it. Let the vibes guide you.

title: The Metric of the Circle-Back Paradigm
core_theme: The linguistic deferral of real human accountability.
narrative_spec: Deconstruct ANY workplace jargon into a religious momento.

title: The Dialectics of the LinkedIn Promotion Announcement
core_theme: The public translation of identity into corporate propaganda.
narrative_spec: Analyze your feelings about training videos...

title: The Blueprint of the Dual-Monitor Void
core_theme: The panoramic imprisonment of the human visual field.
narrative_spec: Can you reframe a workspace into a space of everyday life? ...lets try

title: The Sinking Index of the Q3 Town Hall
core_theme: The performance of executive invulnerability during a decline.
narrative_spec: Describe the last time you felt genuine frusturation in a workplace... let LOOSE... in a poem of course, only so loose you can get.

title: The Sovereignty of the 11:45 PM Slack Notification
core_theme: The digital dissolution of the boundary between rest and work.
narrative_spec: If you have work related anxiety see if you can dance around the pangs as you write a poem about it. Good luck!

title: The Liturgy of the Industrial Office Coffee Machine
core_theme: The cheap chemical stimulation of a captive workforce.
narrative_spec: Set the poem around a leased espresso or coffee dispenser in a corporate breakroom. Describe the JUICE.
